# Week 5 — Visual QA log

**Source:** `docs/pptx/week-5-supervisor.pptx` (28 slides, regenerated by `scripts/build_pptx_week_5.py`)

## Method
1. `soffice --headless --convert-to pdf` → PDF
2. `pdftoppm -jpeg -r 80` → one JPEG per defect/sanity slide
3. Walked the flagged content slides and sampled the cover and a 3-card content slide for regressions.

## Defects found and fixed in `scripts/build_pptx_week_5.py`
- **Two-line H1s overflowed the gold rule and collided with the module badge.** Slides 4 ("Five modules · 30 minutes (or 60–90 in joint mode)") and 10 ("The language your section is listening for") used `add_slide_head` with a fixed 0.7" title box, so the second line of the H1 wrapped under the rule on slide 4 and overlapped the "MODULE 2 · CULTURE" badge on slide 10. **Fix:** added `_estimate_visible_lines` (matches the Week 6 pattern with `char_w = 0.62 * pt / 72`); `add_slide_head` now sizes the H1 box as `max(0.50, line_h * lines + 0.18)` and positions the rule from `max(badge_bottom, title_bottom) + 0.10"`, so the rule clears both the badge and the (possibly multi-line) title.

## Verified after fix
- Slide 1 (cover): unchanged — single-line title, lede, and the three pill chips render correctly.
- Slide 4 ("Five modules · 30 minutes…"): 2-line title sits above the rule; the agenda table starts cleanly below.
- Slide 10 ("The language your section is listening for"): 2-line title clears the "MODULE 2 · CULTURE" badge on the left; both columns ("WHAT 'YES' SOUNDS LIKE" / "WHAT KILLS ADOPTION") are clear of the title.
- Slide 25 ("Tools your Marines will use"): 3-card row + always-callout — unchanged, no regression.

## How to re-run the QA
```sh
uv run python3 scripts/build_pptx_week_5.py
soffice --headless -env:UserInstallation=file:///tmp/sof-5 \
  --convert-to pdf --outdir /tmp/qa-week5 docs/pptx/week-5-supervisor.pptx
pdftoppm -jpeg -r 80 /tmp/qa-week5/week-5-supervisor.pdf /tmp/qa-week5/slide
```
